newsitem.title: PERU: Mariachis serenade Peru hostage for birthday.
newsitem.headline: Mariachis serenade Peru hostage for birthday.

text.p: A band of Mexican mariachi musicians sang a birthday serenade on Thursday to a Peruvian government minister who is among 74 hostages being held by Marxist rebels in Lima.

The sombrero-clad mariachis, taken to the besieged residence of the Japanese ambassador to Peru by relatives of Deputy Energy Minister Jorge San Roman, sang the traditional birthday song "Las Mananitas", witnesses said.
"Jorge, We Love You," a placard held up by one of San Roman's relatives read. San Roman will be 57 on Friday.
Rebels of the Tupac Amaru Revolutionary Movement stormed the residence Dec. 17 to demand the release of some 400 jailed colleagues, and are still holding 74 captives.
